batchRequest.request: Add a Science tab with three headlines.

patchOf:

tabBusiness = TabItem("business", "Business", businessContent)
tabTech = TabItem("tech", "Tech", techContent)
tabSport = TabItem("sport", "Sport", sportContent)
worldContent = [w1, w2, w3]
